required_concepts: two pairs of adjacent sides are equal
optional_concepts: one pair of opposite angles equal
acceptable_paraphrases: tetragon with two distinct pairs of equal adjacent sides
a quadrilateral where only the edges, not the corners, are equally matched in pairs
critical_errors: identifying it as a parallelogram or rectangle
claiming all four sides are equal
stating that opposite sides are parallel
misconceptions: describing it as a square or rhombus
mentioning only one pair of equal sides
grading_notes: Credit for including all required concepts and avoiding critical errors, with partial credit for optional concepts.
